description: JSON Schema for the All The Bacteria file index TSV.

project.description: the name of the project/component, plus its parents, with the names separated by /. For example the Metadata component sits directly under the main AllTheBacteria project, and is called AlTheBacteria/Metadata.

project_id.description: the project identifier. This is useful if you want to make your own file list (see below)

url.description: the URL of the file on the osf server

md5.description: the MD5 sum of the file

size(MB).description: size of the file in MB

title: JSON Schema for the All The Bacteria index file.
